page.layout: One column of running text, with a centred section numeral "II." and a catchword at lower right. No marginal notes. The references after "defendere." are italic text in the column.

main_text.p: dum eam esse concessam adversus quemcunque. Est enim permissa adversus vim atque injuriam: sicut vel vim vel injuriam realem adesse suffecerit. Eamque de facto inferri, licet à parte inferentis injuriandi defit animus. Neque enim tam sese fundat jus naturale in injuriâ, prout est contumelia, quam quidem in damno, quod arcet, qui se tuetur. Ex eo quod naturalis ratio adversus periculum permittat se defendere. l. 3 D. de Iustit. & Jur. l.4. in init. D ad l. Aquil. l 1. §. 27. D. de vi & de vi armat. l. 1. Cod. Unde vi. l. 2. Cod. ad l Cornel. de Sicar.
An igitur reo juste condemnato licebit se tueri adversus carnificem, lictorem, aliosque justitiæ ministros? Non equidem. Tenetur enim ad pœnam justam, non tamen ad eandem

page.notes: The reading "adesse" in "suffecerit" line is taken from the long-s ligature "adeffe". "quidem" is clear. The "à" in "licet à parte" is printed as à. The small mark at the right edge beside "de Iustit." is a stray printer's mark, not a note. The reference line is set in italic inside the text column, so it is treated as running text, not as a margin note.
